description: Build an unsigned swap transaction for the taker wallet to sign and submit. Costs an x402 toll (paid automatically when TOLLBOOTH_PAYER_KEY is set). Returns the transaction, the quote, and a signed receipt.

amount.description: Sell amount as an integer string in the input token's base units

inputToken.description: Token being sold: mint address (solana) or ERC-20 address (EVM chains)

outputToken.description: Token being bought: mint address (solana) or ERC-20 address (EVM chains)

safeMode.description: Screen both tokens first; refuses the build if either is critical-risk (honeypot etc.)

taker.description: Wallet address that will sign and send the swap

name: build_swap

error.description: Present when the request failed or payment is required

quote.description: Quote the transaction was built from

safety.description: Safety reports when safeMode was requested

transaction.description: Unsigned transaction for the taker to sign

title: Build swap transaction
